findings.detail: Description of "track_hotel_price" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hotels, get_refund_guide, draft_refund_request · Private data: get_price_history, check_refund_claim · Public sink: get_price_history, get_current_price · Destructive: track_hotel_price.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_hotels, get_refund_guide, draft_refund_request · Private data: get_price_history, check_refund_claim · Public sink: get_price_history, get_current_price · Destructive: track_hotel_price

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_hotels" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
